Also, I want to exchange the jigsaw puzzle from the same order for one with the same difficulty but with 1000 more pieces, and I’d prefer an art theme over animals if that’s possible.

Additionally, I’d like to exchange my camera for one with a slightly lower resolution, but I want to keep all the other features the same. For both exchanges, I’d like to use my Visa card for any payments or refunds.

Lastly, I want to cancel just the skateboard from one of my orders. Can you help me with all of this?

Yes—I can help with exchanges and a cancellation, but I first need to authenticate your identity.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I verify your profile, I’ll look up the relevant orders/items so I can confirm the exact **order IDs, item IDs**, and the **new item options** before I ask you to approve the changes.
